description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Differential 8 Piece Thrust Washer Kit.
These special washers go between your spider gears and differential case to protect the soft cast iron carrier surfaces from being galled up by the harder spider gears.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – T: 0.9 Thrust Washers 09160-35006
Qty 2 – T: 1.0 Thrust Washers 09160-35002
Qty 2 – T: 1.1 Thrust Washers 09160-35003
Qty 2 – T: 1.2 Thrust Washers 09160-35004
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
